title: folder-sync pull record, version 1
description: <root>_changes/<project>/<host-id>/pulls/<at>.json: the peer files one machine wrote to (or removed from) its disk in one round, each with its online-to-disk time (down_ms). Written once, after a round that applied at least one peer file, by that machine only; never rewritten; deleted by the pruner 30 days after `at`. The online half of the activity log's downloads, so a page can show how long each sync took in both directions. <at> is this record's `at` (RFC 3339 UTC, to the millisecond). See docs/CONTRACT.md, 'Sync times'.

at.description: When the round finished writing; equals the key's <at>.

events.description: In (peer, path) order, at least one. download and remove_copy events, each a full folder-sync-event/1 line with project, host and host_name equal to this record's, and peer_seq.
